result.summary: The home tab is selected in the content (DELIVER TO, categories, restaurant lists) but the bottom navigation highlights Profile instead of Home, which is a major navigation inconsistency. No other visual defects beyond allowed carousel/viewport clipping.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows Profile as the active tab (green icon and label) while the screen is clearly the Home/delivery feed with address, search, category chips, promo, and restaurant lists. Home is inactive/gray.
issues.suggestion: Sync tab selection with the current route so Home is highlighted on this screen and Profile is only active on the profile screen.
